{{Nihongo|'''Hideo Hosono'''|細野秀雄|Hosono Hideo|born September 7, 1953}} is a Japanese [[material scientist]] most known for the discovery of [[iron-based superconductor]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://archive.sciencewatch.com/dr/erf/2008/08decerf/08decerfHoso/|title=Hideo Hosono ScienceWatch.com December 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131004215719/http://archive.sciencewatch.com/dr/erf/2008/08decerf/08decerfHoso/|archive-date=2013-10-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1021/ja800073m| pmid = 18293989 |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/5558258| title = Iron-Based Layered Superconductor La[O<sub>1−x</sub>F<sub>x</sub>]FeAs (x = 0.05–0.12) with ''T<sub>c</sub>''= 26 K| journal = Journal of the American Chemical Society| volume = 130| issue = 11| pages = 3296–7| year = 2008| last1 = Kamihara | first1 = Y. | last2 = Watanabe | first2 = T. | last3 = Hirano | first3 = M. | last4 = Hosono | first4 = H. }}</ref>

Hosono, [[Hideki Shirakawa]] and [[Yoshinori Ohsumi]] are the three keynote speakers at the Institute of Integrated Research (IIR) founding lecture at the [[Institute of Science Tokyo]].<ref>[https://news.mynavi.jp/techplus/article/20161014-iir_titech/3 白川・大隅・細野教授が語る「科学研究のために大切なこと」 - 東工大・科学技術創成研究院設立記念講演会 | TECH+（テックプラス）]</ref>

==Early life and education ==
Hosono was born in September 1953 in [[Saitama Prefecture]], Japan, one of the satellite cities of [[Tokyo]]. Dropped out of high school (National Institute of Technology, Tokyo College) in 1974, graduated from the Department of Industrial Chemistry of [[Tokyo Metropolitan University]] (TMU) in 1977, and obtained a doctorate in engineering from TMU in 1982.

==Career and research ==
Hosono is also a pioneer in developing transparent oxide semiconductors: he proposed a material design concept for a transparent amorphous oxide semiconductor (TAOS) with large [[electron mobility]], demonstrated the excellent performance of TAOS [[thin-film transistor]]s for next generation displays and successfully converted a cement constituent 12CaO·7Al2O3 into transparent [[semiconductor]], metal, and eventually [[superconductor]]s.<ref>[https://www.fpdchina.org/downloadFile/1306379827875.pdf Hideo Hosono]. fpdchina.org</ref><ref>[http://www.materia.titech.ac.jp/English/LaboratoryProfile/Hosono.html LaboratoryProfile – Hosono]. materia.titech.ac.jp</ref><ref>Hideo Hosono (2014) "Impression-Inspired Materials Research", [https://vimeo.com/103881418 Vimeo] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2HdWTwf-QwA Youtube].</ref>

* 2016 – [[Japan Prize]]
* 2017 – Elected a [[Foreign Member of the Royal Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/hideo-hosono-13396|title=Hideo Hosono ForMemRS|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170523130244/https://royalsociety.org/people/hideo-hosono-13396/|archive-date=2017-05-23}}</ref>

* 2022 – [[Eduard Rhein Foundation|Eduard Rhein Technology Award]]<ref>[https://www.eduard-rhein-stiftung.de/en/awardees/chronology/ Eduard Rhein Technology Award 2022]</ref>
